subject: Enemy
text: You can push an enemy only if your level is higher than that monster.

evidence.quote:
You will be able to push an enemy, only if your level is higher than 
that monster (you can’t see the level of the enemy though).

subject: GamePak
text: The GamePak cartridge has 2 save slots, allowing one saved game per slot.

evidence.quote:
The GamePak (Gameboy Cartridge) of Final Fantasy Adventure has 2 Slots. You 
can save 1 Game for every slot.

subject: Soft Reset
text: Pressing the A, B, Select, and Start buttons at the same time resets the game without saving.

evidence.quote:
Press the A, B, Select, and Start buttons at the same time. 
Note that doing this won’t save your game.

subject: Cure
text: Cure restores character HP and costs 2 MP.

evidence.quote: Cure  = Restores your character’s HP (2 MP)

subject: Heal
text: Heal removes any status ailment except Moog and costs 1 MP.

evidence.quote: Heal  = Remove any Status Ailment (except Moog) (1 MP)

subject: Slep
text: Slep puts enemies within the area to sleep and costs 1 MP.

evidence.quote:
Slep  = It lull’s enemies within the area into sleep (some are impervious
        to this magic spell (1 MP)

subject: Mute
text: Mute disables enemy casting abilities and costs 1 MP.

evidence.quote:
Mute  = This will disable the casting abilities of your enemy. Some cannot
        Be inflicted with this Magic Spell (1 MP)

subject: Fire
text: Fire costs 1 MP and throws a fireball that automatically chases the nearest enemy even outside the screen area.

evidence.quote:
Fire  = Throw a small fireball to the nearest enemy. This fireball will 
        Automatically chase your enemy even outside the screen area of the 
        Gameboy. (1 MP)

subject: Ice
text: Ice costs 2 MP and throws an iceberg that turns enemies into snowmen which can be pushed to activate floor switches.

evidence.quote:
Ice   = Throws a small IceBerg on your enemies. Some enemies turn into 
        Snowmen after being hit by the IceBerg. You can then push them to
        Activate floor switches. IceBerg can be controlled by using the 
        Directional pad. If you accidentally hit a wall, the IceBerg will  
        Disappear. (2 MP)

subject: Lit
text: Lit costs 2 MP and throws a lightning bolt straight to enemies in front of the player.

evidence.quote:
Lit   = Throws a Lightning Bolt straight to the enemies in front of you.
        (2 MP)

subject: Nuke
text: Nuke costs 3 MP and hurls a ball of nuclear energy that travels in a straight line.

evidence.quote:
Nuke  = Strongest Magic Attack. Hurls a ball of Nuclear Energy at your
        Enemies. It travels in a straight line only though. (3 MP)

subject: Death
text: The Nuke Magic can be obtained by defeating Death.

evidence.quote: The Nuke Magic, can be obtained by beating Death.

subject: Inventory
text: The inventory can hold up to 16 different items.

evidence.quote: You can have 16 different items in your inventory.

subject: Pure Item
text: Each item has a maximum quantity, such as Pure Item being maxed out at 3.

evidence.quote:
Each of your items has a maximum quantity. Example, Pure Item is MAXed out at 
3.

subject: Shield
text: Equipping a shield when your character's level is about 70 allows you to push weak enemies out of the way without taking damage.

evidence.quote:
Another note on Shields. If your character’s Level is high enough. Let’s say 
about 70. You can push the pathetic enemies out of your way. If you are weak, 
you’ll get damage.
